name: devShark
tagline: Learn web development with graded quizzes, 770 server-graded coding tasks and a streak that forgives you.
description: devShark (devshark.app) is a one-developer learning platform for web developers: guided Learn paths (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and more), 1,974 served quiz questions, 770 coding tasks graded on the server (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Algorithms, system design), a daily challenge, the survival Biggest Shark Challenge, multiplayer rooms, a typing racer, forgiving streaks, 30-day leaderboards, coins and an optional GitHub garden that commits every passed task to the learner's own repo. Freemium since 25 September 2026: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React levels 1–12 and 116 of the 770 tasks are free; Premium is 3.99 EUR/month or 39.99 EUR/year VAT included, opened by voucher codes while Stripe checkout is off. Public launch on social: Thursday 5 November 2026.
audience: English-speaking self-taught and junior web developers (18–34) preparing for a first frontend/fullstack job or moving into React/TypeScript; they follow dev-education accounts (freeCodeCamp, roadmap.sh, Boot.dev, JavaScript Mastery, Fireship, Kevin Powell) on Instagram and Threads, save carousels, answer quiz posts, reply on Threads and many do Advent of Code in December. Global, US-heavy, with the UK, India and the EU as large slices; Czech audience secondary (product is English-only).
goal: Launch devShark on Threads and Instagram on 5 Nov 2026 and grow followers from a zero baseline with original product evidence, nudging sign-ups toward Premium (3.99 EUR/month) at Black Friday/Cyber Monday with an honest voucher.
